# Information Security Management Certificate

Cybranytech FZ-LLC operates an information security management system
certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022.

Certificate number: IS-664120.
Scope: Provision of cybersecurity assessment, penetration testing and security
consulting services from the Dubai office.
Original certification: 15 March 2022.
Expiry date: 14 March 2025.

The certified scope covers information handling, access control, cryptography,
supplier management and incident response for all client engagement data.
